paragraphs: Tesla, Inc. ( TEZ-lə or   TESS-lə) is an American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles (BEVs), stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.

The company was incorporated in July 2003 by Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning as Tesla Motors. Its name is a tribute to the inventor and electrical engineer Nikola Tesla. In February 2004, Elon Musk led Tesla's first funding round and became the company's chairman, subsequently claiming to be a co-founder; in 2008, he was named chief executive officer. The company began production of its first car model, the Roadster sports car, in 2008; the Model S sedan in 2012; the Model X SUV in 2015; the Model 3 sedan in 2017; the Model Y crossover in 2020; the Tesla Semi truck in 2022; and the Cybertruck pickup truck in 2023.

Tesla is one of the world's most valuable companies in terms of market capitalization. Starting in July 2020, it has been the world's most valuable automaker. From October 2021 to March 2022, Tesla was a US$1 trillion company, the sixth US company to reach that valuation. In 2023, the company was ranked 69th in the Forbes Global 2000. In 2024, the company led the battery electric vehicle market, with 17.6% share.

Tesla exceeded $1 trillion in market capitalization again between November 2024 and February 2025, and from May 2025 to July 2026. In November 2025, Tesla approved a pay package worth $1 trillion for Musk, which he is to receive over 10 years if he meets specific goals. By the end of 2025, the company lost its status as world's leading manufacturer of electric vehicles.

Tesla has been the subject of lawsuits, boycotts, government scrutiny, and journalistic criticism, stemming from allegations of multiple cases of whistleblower retaliation, worker rights violations such as sexual harassment and anti-union activities, safety defects leading to dozens of recalls, the lack of a public relations department, and controversial statements from Musk, including overpromising on the company's driving assist technology and product release timelines.

people.name: Elon Musk
people.title: Technoking of Tesla and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Musk has served as Tesla's Chief Executive Officer since October 2008 and as a director since 2004. He previously co-founded PayPal and Zip2 Corporation.
people.quote: Mr. Musk is the Technoking of Tesla and has served as our Chief Executive Officer since October 2008.

people.name: Vaibhav Taneja
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Taneja has served as Tesla's Chief Financial Officer since August 2023, previously serving as Chief Accounting Officer, Corporate Controller and Assistant Corporate Controller. He served in various finance and accounting roles at SolarCity from March 2016.
people.quote: Vaibhav Taneja has served as our Chief Financial Officer since August 2023.

people.name: Xiaotong (Tom) Zhu
people.title: Senior Vice President, APAC and Global Vehicle Manufacturing
people.bio: Zhu has served as Senior Vice President since April 2023 and in his current role since June 2025. He joined Tesla in April 2014 and previously served as Vice President, Greater China, leading the construction and operations of Gigafactory Shanghai.
people.quote: Tom Zhu has served as our Senior Vice President since April 2023

people.name: Robyn Denholm
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Ms. Denholm has been Chair of the Board since November 2018. She previously held executive roles at Telstra and Juniper Networks, including Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operations Officer.
people.quote: Ms. Denholm has been Chair of the Board since November 2018.

people.name: Ira Ehrenpreis
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Ehrenpreis has been a venture capitalist since 1996 and is a founder and managing member of DBL Partners, formed in 2015. Previously, he led the Energy Innovation practice at Technology Partners.
people.quote: Mr. Ehrenpreis has been a venture capitalist since 1996.

people.name: Joe Gebbia
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Gebbia co-founded Airbnb in 2008 and has served on its board since 2009. He launched Samara, which produces factory-made homes, in 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Gebbia co-founded Airbnb, Inc. in 2008 and has served on Airbnb's board of directors since 2009.

people.name: Jack Hartung
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Hartung served as Chipotle's President and Chief Strategy Officer from October 2024 to May 2025 and subsequently as a senior advisor until retiring in March 2026. Before joining Chipotle in 2002, he spent 18 years at McDonald's.
people.quote: Mr. Hartung brings a proven track record of executive leadership, with experience overseeing financial and reporting functions at multiple public companies.

people.name: James Murdoch
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Murdoch has been Chief Executive Officer of Lupa Systems, which he founded, since March 2019. Previously, he held leadership roles at Twenty-First Century Fox, including Chief Executive Officer from 2015 to March 2019.
people.quote: Mr. Murdoch has been the Chief Executive Officer of Lupa Systems, a private holding company that he founded, since March 2019.

people.name: Kimbal Musk
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Kimbal Musk is co-founder and Executive Chairman of The Kitchen Restaurant Group. He founded Nova Sky Stories in 2022 and serves as its Chief Executive Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Kimbal Musk has extensive senior leadership business experience in the technology, retail and consumer markets, and a robust understanding of mission-driven ventures.

people.name: JB Straubel
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Straubel is Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Redwood Materials. He co-founded Tesla and served as its Chief Technology Officer from May 2005 to July 2019.
people.quote: Mr. Straubel also co-founded and served as the Chief Technology Officer of Tesla from May 2005 to July 2019.

people.name: Kathleen Wilson-Thompson
people.title: Director
people.bio: Kathleen Wilson-Thompson is listed as a member of the Compensation Committee, which consists solely of independent directors.
